formdata.value: A Commercial Ecosystem Powering Business Excellence

KB Central is a future-ready commercial destination designed to elevate business visibility, customer engagement, and long-term growth. Strategically located in Greater Noida, the development brings together premium retail, dining, wellness, entertainment, hospitality, and event experiences within a vibrant commercial ecosystem. With over 47,000 sq. ft. of retail space spread across six levels, KB Central is crafted to become a landmark destination for leading brands, businesses, and investors.
Positioned at the Heart of Opportunity

Located in one of Greater Noida's most promising commercial corridors, KB Central is surrounded by thriving residential neighbourhoods, leading educational institutions, business hubs, and transformative infrastructure. Set in Uttar Pradesh's fastest-growing economic region and strategically connected to the upcoming Noida International Airport at Jewar, KB Central stands at the crossroads of commerce, connectivity, and long-term appreciation.

KB Central offers excellent accessibility through a well-established network of roads and transport infrastructure. Its strategic location ensures smooth connectivity to key destinations across the wider NCR region
Spread across six levels, KB Central offers over 47,000 sq. ft. of thoughtfully planned retail space designed to maximize footfall and brand exposure.
A compelling platform for entertainment brands seeking high visibility and sustained audience engagement through its integrated commercial ecosystem.
KB Central offers dedicated spaces for fitness, beauty, and holistic health brands, creating a unique space for premium lifestyle experiences and thus encouraging footfall.

KB Central provides brands with a versatile platform to engage audiences, and generate meaningful business opportunities. The event space serves as a key footfall driver within the larger commercial ecosystem

Complementing the retail and lifestyle ecosystem is a world-class 5-star hospitality experience. The premium hospitality offering enhances the destination's appeal while contributing to sustained footfall throughout the year.
Double-basement parking complemented by rare authority-approved front parking
24x7 security, uninterrupted power backup, and smart infrastructure.

Avora Group is built on a strong foundation of real estate excellence and institutional trust. Founded by highly skilled and experienced industry veterans Mr. Naveen Jindal and Mr. Ashish Gupta, the group carries forward the rich legacy and proven track record established during their tenure as founding partners of the renowned KB Group

We are a forward-looking development firm dedicated to creating premium, high-street commercial assets. Our approach is rooted strictly in the builder’s perspective—prioritizing architectural integrity, long-term asset value, and uncompromising quality over standard market offerings.
